entities.summary: Oleg Olegovich Khorzhan was a Transnistrian politician who served as the longtime chairman of the Transnistrian Communist Party and as a member of Transnistria's Supreme Council. He was a vocal critic of the Transnistrian government and led protests advocating economic and social reforms.
